CustomField.inlineHelpText: Splits this definition into SEPARATE tables, one per distinct value - alternative proposals, consumption scenarios, purchasing entities. Different from grouping: grouping nests rows inside one table under one grand total, partitioning produces several tables each with its own total and nothing spanning them. Accepts the same dimension names as a grouping. Blank means one table, which is every ordinary definition.
CustomField.label: Partition Dimension
